import type { GrammarMood } from '../types'

// Sgt. Apostrophe: a round officer with a siren on the hat. 1 SVG per mood.

const INK = '#3a2e1f'
const SKIN = '#FFD166'
const NAVY = '#2B3A67'
const MOUTH = '#8b2e3c'

function siren(isOn: boolean): string {
  const flash = isOn
    ? '<animate attributeName="fill" values="#ff4d4d;#4d7cff;#ff4d4d" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
    : ''
  const glow = isOn
    ? `<circle cx="80" cy="13" r="12" fill="#ff4d4d" opacity="0.35">${flash}
         <animate attributeName="r" values="9;16;9" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>`
    : ''
  return `${glow}
    <path d="M73 21 Q80 4 87 21 Z" fill="${isOn ? '#ff4d4d' : '#9aa0aa'}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2">${flash}</path>
    <rect x="71" y="20" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#5b6070" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`
}

function hat(tilt: number, isSirenOn: boolean): string {
  return `<g transform="rotate(${tilt} 80 56)">
    <path d="M50 60 L54 30 Q80 20 106 30 L110 60 Z" fill="${NAVY}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="49" y="52" width="62" height="9" rx="3" fill="#1b2547"/>
    <path d="M80 33 L82.4 38.6 L88.5 39 L83.8 42.8 L85.3 48.7 L80 45.4 L74.7 48.7 L76.2 42.8 L71.5 39 L77.6 38.6 Z" fill="#FFC300" stroke="#a87b00" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M42 60 Q80 74 118 60 Q118 66 112 67 Q80 78 48 67 Q42 66 42 60 Z" fill="#141a33" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
    ${siren(isSirenOn)}
  </g>`
}

function face(mood: GrammarMood): string {
  const blush = `<ellipse cx="57" cy="104" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ff8fa3" opacity="0.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="103" cy="104" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ff8fa3" opacity="0.6"/>`
  const smile = `<path d="M68 105 Q80 122 92 105 Z" fill="${MOUTH}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`
  const happyEyes = `<path d="M59 93 Q66 82 73 93 M87 93 Q94 82 101 93" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>`

  switch (mood) {
    case 'arrest':
      return `
        <ellipse cx="66" cy="90" rx="7" ry="8" fill="#fff" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <ellipse cx="94" cy="90" rx="7" ry="8" fill="#fff" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="67" cy="92" r="3.5" fill="${INK}"/>
        <circle cx="93" cy="92" r="3.5" fill="${INK}"/>
        <path d="M56 76 L74 83 M104 76 L86 83" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        ${blush}
        <rect x="72" y="106" width="15" height="8" rx="3" fill="#c9d1e0" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="90" cy="110" r="5.5" fill="#c9d1e0" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <path d="M100 104 q4 6 0 12 M106 100 q6 10 0 20" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>`
    case 'shocked':
      return `
        <circle cx="66" cy="89" r="10" fill="#fff" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="94" cy="89" r="10" fill="#fff" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="66" cy="89" r="2.5" fill="${INK}"/>
        <circle cx="94" cy="89" r="2.5" fill="${INK}"/>
        <path d="M56 74 Q66 68 75 74 M85 74 Q94 68 104 74" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        ${blush}
        <ellipse cx="80" cy="113" rx="5" ry="7" fill="${MOUTH}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`
    case 'sleepy':
      return `
        <path d="M59 90 Q66 97 73 90 M87 90 Q94 97 101 90" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        ${blush}
        <ellipse cx="80" cy="110" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="${MOUTH}"/>`
    case 'happy':
    case 'medal':
      return `${happyEyes}${blush}${smile}`
  }
}

const restArm = `<path d="M36 104 Q26 112 28 121" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="124" r="6" fill="${SKIN}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`

const waveArm = `<g>
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-14 124 100;14 124 100;-14 124 100" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <path d="M124 100 Q138 86 138 72" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="138" cy="66" r="7" fill="${SKIN}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>
</g>`

const saluteArm = `<path d="M124 100 Q134 78 116 66" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="113" cy="64" r="6" fill="${SKIN}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`

const donutArm = `<path d="M124 104 Q134 112 132 120" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="141" cy="117" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#e8a87c" stroke-width="6"/>
  <circle cx="141" cy="117" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#ff8fb1" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="30 14"/>
  <path d="M137 112 l2 1 M144 113 l1 2 M140 121 l2 0" stroke="#4d7cff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="132" cy="122" r="6" fill="${SKIN}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`

function exclaim(): string {
  return [
    [16, 52, 0],
    [30, 34, 0.3],
  ]
    .map(
      ([x, y, begin]) => `<text x="${x}" y="${y}" font-family="Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="22" fill="#ff4d4d" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="1">!
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.15;1" dur="0.6s" begin="${begin}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>`,
    )
    .join('')
}

const sweat = `<path d="M112 72 q5 8 0 11 q-5 -3 0 -11 Z" fill="#7cc7ff" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="1.5">
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 14" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
</path>`

function sparkles(): string {
  return [
    [14, 70, 0],
    [134, 40, 0.4],
    [20, 132, 0.8],
    [146, 100, 1.1],
  ]
    .map(
      ([x, y, begin]) => `<text x="${x}" y="${y}" font-size="15" fill="#FFC300" opacity="0">✦
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="1.2s" begin="${begin}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>`,
    )
    .join('')
}

function zzz(): string {
  return [0, 0.8, 1.6]
    .map(
      begin => `<text x="112" y="56" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="14" fill="#8aa0c8" opacity="0">z
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.4s" begin="${begin}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;14 -36" dur="2.4s" begin="${begin}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>`,
    )
    .join('')
}

const medal = `<path d="M56 110 L63 124 L70 110" stroke="#4d7cff" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="129" r="8" fill="#FFC300" stroke="#a87b00" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M63 124 L64.4 127.3 L68 127.6 L65.3 129.9 L66.1 133.4 L63 131.5 L59.9 133.4 L60.7 129.9 L58 127.6 L61.6 127.3 Z" fill="#fff6c2"/>`

function confetti(): string {
  const colors = ['#ff4d4d', '#4d7cff', '#FFC300', '#3ecf8e', '#ff8fb1']
  return [12, 34, 58, 96, 118, 140, 150, 24]
    .map((x, i) => {
      const dur = (1.6 + (i % 3) * 0.4).toFixed(1)
      const begin = (i * 0.25).toFixed(2)
      return `<rect x="${x}" y="-8" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="${colors[i % colors.length]}">
        <animate attributeName="y" values="-8;150" dur="${dur}s" begin="${begin}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>`
    })
    .join('')
}

function motion(mood: GrammarMood): string {
  switch (mood) {
    case 'arrest':
    case 'shocked':
      return '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;-3 0;3 0;-3 0;3 0;0 0" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="3"/>'
    case 'happy':
    case 'medal':
      return '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -7;0 0" dur="0.45s" repeatCount="5"/>'
    case 'sleepy':
      return '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 1.5;0 0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
  }
}

// The frame of an animated SVG has a white background, so each mood fills it with a scene.
function backdrop(mood: GrammarMood): string {
  switch (mood) {
    case 'arrest':
    case 'shocked': {
      const lines = [30, 52, 74, 96, 118]
        .map(
          (y, i) => `<line x1="0" y1="${y}" x2="160" y2="${y}" stroke="#9c9381" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <text x="4" y="${y - 3}" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" fill="#7d7464">${7 - i}'</text>`,
        )
        .join('')
      return `<rect width="160" height="150" fill="#e9e3d3"/>${lines}
        <rect x="0" y="136" width="160" height="14" fill="#cfc6b0"/>`
    }
    case 'happy':
      return `<defs><linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9fd8ff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e6f6ff"/></linearGradient></defs>
        <rect width="160" height="150" fill="url(#sky)"/>
        <g fill="#fff" opacity="0.9">
          <ellipse cx="26" cy="30" rx="16" ry="7"/><ellipse cx="36" cy="25" rx="10" ry="7"/>
          <ellipse cx="134" cy="88" rx="16" ry="7"/><ellipse cx="142" cy="83" rx="9" ry="6"/>
        </g>
        <rect x="0" y="138" width="160" height="12" fill="#8fd17a"/>`
    case 'sleepy':
      return `<defs><linearGradient id="night" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1b2445"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#34436f"/></linearGradient></defs>
        <rect width="160" height="150" fill="url(#night)"/>
        <circle cx="134" cy="26" r="11" fill="#fff3c4"/><circle cx="139" cy="22" r="10" fill="#222c50"/>
        <g fill="#fff">
          <circle cx="20" cy="22" r="1.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
          <circle cx="44" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="104" cy="16" r="1.2"/>
          <circle cx="150" cy="58" r="1"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
          <circle cx="12" cy="70" r="1"/>
        </g>
        <rect x="0" y="138" width="160" height="12" fill="#2a3558"/>`
    case 'medal':
      return `<defs><linearGradient id="stage" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3b2a6b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6b3fa0"/></linearGradient></defs>
        <rect width="160" height="150" fill="url(#stage)"/>
        <path d="M66 0 L94 0 L136 150 L24 150 Z" fill="#fff6c2" opacity="0.22">
          <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.14;0.3;0.14" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
        <rect x="0" y="138" width="160" height="12" fill="#2b1d4f"/>`
  }
}

export function mascot(mood: GrammarMood, id: number): string {
  const isSirenOn = mood === 'arrest' || mood === 'shocked' || mood === 'medal'
  const arm =
    mood === 'sleepy' ? donutArm : mood === 'happy' || mood === 'medal' ? saluteArm : waveArm
  const before = mood === 'medal' ? confetti() : ''
  const after =
    mood === 'arrest'
      ? exclaim()
      : mood === 'shocked'
        ? exclaim() + sweat
        : mood === 'sleepy'
          ? zzz()
          : sparkles() + (mood === 'medal' ? medal : '')

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 160 150" width="160" height="150" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><!-- scene ${id} -->
  ${backdrop(mood)}
  ${before}
  <g>${motion(mood)}
    <ellipse cx="66" cy="141" rx="10" ry="4.5" fill="${INK}"/>
    <ellipse cx="94" cy="141" rx="10" ry="4.5" fill="${INK}"/>
    <path d="M80 48 C114 48 126 74 126 98 C126 124 106 140 80 140 C54 140 34 124 34 98 C34 74 46 48 80 48 Z" fill="${SKIN}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3"/>
    ${restArm}
    ${face(mood)}
    ${hat(mood === 'sleepy' ? -14 : 0, isSirenOn)}
    ${arm}
    ${after}
  </g>
</svg>`
}

// The terminal has no SVG: a small face in text.
export const ASCII: Record<GrammarMood, string[]> = {
  arrest: ['  _[!]_ ', ' /_____\\', ' ( >_< )', '  /| |\\ '],
  shocked: ['  _[!]_ ', ' /_____\\', ' ( O_O )', '  \\| |/ '],
  happy: ['  _[*]_ ', ' /_____\\', ' ( ^_^ )', '  /| |\\ '],
  sleepy: ['   _[ ]_', '  /_____\\', ' ( -_- ) z', '  /| |o  '],
  medal: ['  _[*]_ ', ' /_____\\', ' ( ^o^ )', '  /|@|\\ '],
}
